activity_statements.statement: provides a cloud-based AI platform (Now Platform / ServiceNow AI Platform) enabling enterprises to automate workflows, manage IT services, and connect business processes across departments
delivers IT Service Management (ITSM) and IT Operations Management (ITOM/AIOps) software enabling enterprises to manage incident, problem, change, and event workflows
provides Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Customer Service Management (CSM) modules for AI-enhanced customer experience automation
offers HR Service Delivery, Finance & Supply Chain, and Security Operations software modules on a single unified platform for enterprise customers
sells ServiceNow Otto as an agentic AI automation product that executes end-to-end tasks from user requests across enterprise systems

licenses SaaS subscriptions to enterprises of all industries delivering the platform as AI platform for business transformation with sector-specific solutions for banking, healthcare, manufacturing, government, and telecom

name_reality_gap: The name 'ServiceNow' suggests a service desk/IT ticketing tool, which was accurate when founded. The activity reality is a broad enterprise workflow and AI automation platform serving HR, finance, security, CRM, and low-code development in addition to IT — competitors now include Salesforce, SAP, and Microsoft, not just IT helpdesk tools.
extraction_notes: All three pages returned good content. Investor overview page was minimal but confirmed positioning. No 10-K accessed but product pages give comprehensive coverage of the full product catalog.
